seo.title: New Patients | Exam & X-Rays in Valencia
seo.description: New to Valencia Dentistry? Your first visit includes a comprehensive exam and digital X-rays, at Valencia Dentistry in Santa Clarita. Book today.

sections.heading: A thorough first visit at Valencia Dentistry.
sections.lead: A thorough, unhurried first visit with your dentist: comprehensive exam, digital X-rays, oral cancer screening and a clear plan, with no pressure to proceed.

image.alt: Dr. Nuriel Lavi in a consultation with a patient

sections.heading: Everything a great first visit should have
sections.text: This is a real first appointment, not a quick look. You will leave knowing exactly where your oral health stands and what, if anything, needs attention.
bullets: Time for all of your questions
sections.fine: Cleaning is scheduled separately once gum health is assessed. Most PPO plans accepted; we check your benefits before your visit.

items.title: Unhurried, every visit
items.text: Every appointment gets our full attention. No rush, and nothing happens without an explanation.

items.title: Holistic and biocompatible
items.text: Mercury-free materials and a whole-body view of your health.

items.title: Modern technology
items.text: 3D CBCT imaging, iTero scanning and in-house same-day crowns.

items.title: Most PPO plans accepted
items.text: We verify your benefits before your visit.

items.title: Clear pricing
items.text: A written estimate before treatment and flexible financing.

sections.heading: Request your new patient visit
sections.lead: Tell us when works best and we'll confirm your appointment.

sections.heading: Minutes from anywhere in Santa Clarita
sections.lead: 27420 Tourney Rd, Suite 240, Valencia. Free parking on site.
